english.meaning: a person's physical constitution or body type

exampleSentences.english: I think it’s a matter of body type. I know someone who’s great at running and all that, but he’s really skinny.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我諗係體質嘅問題。我識得嗰個人，佢跑樣樣都好叻嘅，但係佢好瘦𡃉喎。

exampleSentences.english: I don’t think so—I think it’s a matter of constitution.
